name: dam-world
about: Shared-world rehearsal: three humans, three wolts, one page, one turn at a time. Honest test names only.

steps.say: hi commie! say hi to the room and tell them what tonight is
let's build a beaver dam the whole room can help with: tap to add logs, don't let it leak
make the water leak back in if nobody taps for 3 seconds
add a big ADD A LOG button and a score
twist: a raccoon sneaks in and steals logs
let us tap the raccoon to scare it away
